comments.text: Very nice spot. Some Cars and trucks going from the gas station (driving slowly) and within walking distance to the highway (if there are not enough cars at the gas station)

comments.text: Good stop going south. Only thing is most cars want money, and most people are stopping to earn money as "taxis". Beware of this and mention if you do not want to pay.
Sign (in Farsi) for Isfahan got me picked up within a few minutes here, the guy who took me could've taken me all the way to Shiraz.
An amazing spot! Just after the tollgates, plenty of traffic going slowly and also people stopping to bless their journey so you can talk to them if you prefer.
